propositions: Gate operations emit no incremental output between invocation and final verdict, causing supervisor watchdogs with 600s budgets to treat healthy long runs as hung and kill them
Long silent phases occur in non-model-call portions: 27s material-assembly prologue and 40s overlap corpus retrieval, which have no instrumentation at any log level
The gate path has no mechanism to emit periodic liveness signals and is deliberately designed without a total-runtime cap per ADR 0089
Closing operations routinely exceed common 600s stall budgets while silent, causing autonomous agents to be killed mid-close and leaving epic/story state stranded
Existing unit tests pin silence-tolerance as correct behaviour, constraining any remediation to purely additive emission that does not introduce total-runtime caps
